The OOM is from the turbo pre-build step running 30+ package builds with default concurrency and no memory limits — not caused by the code changes in this PR (vercel.json was unchanged).

Fixed in `5831b8b` by adding `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` and `--concurrency=3` to the turbo command in `vercel.json`.

These TS errors are pre-existing in `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-detail`, and `plugin-grid` — not caused by this PR's code changes. They surfaced because the OOM fix let turbo get further.

Fixed in `6e4814c` by removing the turbo pre-build step entirely. Vite already compiles all workspace packages from source via `src/` aliases in `vite.config.ts` — turbo is unnecessary and also causes "Unknown component type" runtime errors when resolving from `dist/`.

Also added missing aliases for `@object-ui/mobile` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer` which are imported by the console app. Verified the Vite production build succeeds locally.

> @copilot fix all

All 10 review items fixed in `7dd0547` and `ebac3ca`:

1. Removed unused `_context` param from apiHandler
2. Respect `action.refreshAfter` — only refresh/reload when true
3. Falsy-safe validation with `isMissingValue()` — `0` and `false` no longer blocked
4. `??` instead of `||` for all form input values
5. Number inputs use `valueAsNumber` with NaN guard for empty input
6. Removed unused `within` import
7. Cancel test uses `not.toHaveBeenCalled()`
8. `data` destructured from rest in action-bar — no DOM prop warnings
9. `data` destructured from rest in action-button — no DOM prop warnings
10. Simplified params routing with `Array.isArray` — handles empty arrays correctly

All 764 console tests pass, 12 action-bar tests pass, CodeQL: 0 alerts.
